mechanism_narrative: The accelerating decline in RETAIL_REC mobility over the last four weeks, culminating in a sharp drop to -60.4% in the most recent week, indicates strong negative momentum that will persist, driving further reductions in retail and recreation mobility.
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp and sustained increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility, reaching +38.9% in the last week, reflects strong public adherence to stay-at-home directives, directly reducing all non-essential external activities including retail and recreation.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility decreases by more than 5 percentage points while RETAIL_REC increases over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The dramatic decline in WORKPLACES mobility, with a 34.1 percentage point drop in the last week, signifies widespread business closures and work-from-home mandates, which will continue to suppress associated retail and recreation activities.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 30 percentage points week-on-week at t-0w.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES mobility remains below -60% but RETAIL_REC shows a recovery of more than 10 percentage points within the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The severe and accelerating reduction in TRANSIT station visits, reaching -67.3% in the last week, indicates a collapse in public transportation usage, which acts as a significant barrier to accessing retail and recreation venues, thus further depressing RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility remains below -60% but RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 percentage points over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility in the most recent week, following a period of relative stability, suggests a shift from frequent, smaller trips to less frequent, larger stock-up trips, which reduces overall footfall in commercial areas and negatively impacts RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls by more than 15 percentage points week-on-week at t-0w.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM mobility remains below -15% but RETAIL_REC does not decline further in the next week.

mechanism_narrative: The significant decline in PARKS mobility (-48.9%) coupled with the sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility (+38.9%) indicates a complete cessation of outdoor leisure activities, reinforcing the stay-at-home behavior that will continue to suppress RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -40% AND RESIDENTIAL rises above +30% at t-0w.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility remains below -40% and RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above +30%, but RETAIL_REC shows an increase of more than 5 percentage points over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Given the current severe and widespread declines across all non-residential mobility categories, it is highly probable that strict lockdown policies are in effect and will remain so, ensuring RETAIL_REC stays at its current depressed levels or declines further.
failure_condition: Official policy announcements or observable mobility data indicate an easing of restrictions, leading to an increase in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The extreme low point reached by RETAIL_REC at -60.4% in the most recent week might represent a temporary bottom, leading to a slight, short-term rebound as people make essential, albeit limited, retail trips.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to decline or remains flat (within 2 percentage points) in the next week.
